input: Build a birdhouse with leftover wood scraps

gold.taskTitle: Build a Birdhouse From Leftover Wood Scraps
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to construct a birdhouse using wood scraps they already have on hand.

questions.title: What type of bird are you building this for?
questions.description: Knowing the target bird species determines the required hole size, interior dimensions, and mounting height.

questions.title: What wood scrap sizes and species do you have?
questions.description: Understanding the available lumber dimensions and wood types helps determine if the material is sufficient and suitable for outdoor use.

questions.title: What tools do you currently have access to?
questions.description: Knowing available tools such as a saw, drill, hammer, or sander will shape how the construction steps are planned.

questions.title: Where will the birdhouse be mounted or placed?
questions.description: The intended location, such as a fence post, tree, or pole, affects the design and any required mounting hardware.

questions.title: What is your experience level with woodworking?
questions.description: The user's skill level determines how detailed the instructions need to be and which joinery or techniques to recommend.

questions.title: Do you have a specific design or style in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user wants a simple box design, a decorative cottage style, or another shape guides the planning and cut list.

questions.title: What is your deadline or timeline for this project?
questions.description: Understanding how quickly the user wants to finish helps prioritize steps and determine if any materials need to be sourced quickly.
